name: Karens Unleashed

title._comment_shadow: No drop shadow on the type: the glow below is what lifts it.
_comment_highlight: Highlighting recolours the line and nothing else — no box, no
texture. The outline and the glow belong to every letter, so a
highlighted line keeps both: only the fill changes.

_comment_branding: Title left, subject right — what the automatic framing already
produces, so neither flip is needed.
